title: 第15章 神明的马比咱们人吃的还好第16章 蛮子细作
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 叶苜苜看见战承胤的来信，笑了！
一个小小平板电脑，删除大部分功能，竟能把古人震惊到。
直呼为神迹。
叶苜苜给他回信：“ipad，又叫平板电脑，是现代生活中常见的电子产品。”
“有摄像功能，你慢慢功能摸索，拍下镇关环境传给我，我才知道你们缺少什么。”
叶苜苜想了想，他们用现代方法水泥筑墙当然好。
若蛮族快速集结攻城。
糯米石灰沙土砌墙，古人可以直接上手。
水泥砌墙还得学习，她先采购一批糯米和石灰，尽快送过去。
城墙先修……
“多谢神明，可否再送一批木碳过来，城中树木全被吃光，现在烧火熬粥的木材，是从损坏房屋中拆下来的木板。”
叶苜苜明了。
可以想象镇关什么都没了，光秃秃一片，举目四望全是赤红焦土。
她答应下来。
今日采购任务很大，她把花瓶搬到皮卡车副驾驶，绑好绳子，系上安全带。
把开车出别墅大门。
刚开出小区大门，却被人突地冲出来，拦下她的车。
她定睛一看是大伯娘和奶奶。
她紧急踩刹车，大口喘息，额头渗出汗珠。
好险，差点撞到人！
大伯娘和奶奶站在车前，双眼恨恨的瞪着她。
她的奶奶，一七十多岁的老太太，目露凶光，看她眼神像在看仇人。
“你个丧门星，克死我儿子，如今又害我大孙子被关进去，你下来，今天必须跟我去警局撤案！”
叶苜苜很生气。
她出生以来，因为是个丫头片子，被重男轻女的奶奶嫌弃。
奶奶不止一次在爸爸面前唆使，让爸爸把所有财产都给堂哥。
因为堂哥是老叶家第一个大长孙。
前几天，堂哥和王总被抓进去，记者把王总和堂哥当街绑架她的事报道出来。
上了本地新闻头条。
华王集团连夜发表声明，王总并非华王集团的股东，未在集团担任何职务。
叶家是被王总说的巨额彩礼给骗了。
王总被关进去后，他儿子天天上门闹事，必须让叶家给个说法。
大伯娘和奶奶对叶苜苜恨之入骨，才有小区门口拦车这一幕。
小区有四个大门，其余三个门其他叔伯守着。
老太太见叶苜苜无动于衷，顿时怒了，举起拐杖狠狠砸向叶苜苜的车头。
嘭，嘭……
重型越野发出刺耳的敲击声。
大伯娘使劲拍打她车窗。
content_en:
Ye Mochu saw Zhan Chengyin's letter and smiled!
A small tablet computer with most of its functions removed could shock the ancients.
Call it a miracle.
Ye Miglu replied to him: "iPad, also called tablet computer, is a common electronic product in modern life."
"It has a camera function. You can slowly explore the function, take pictures of the town and pass the environment and send it to me. Then I will know what you are missing."
Ye Clover thought for a while, it would be good if they used modern methods to build the wall with cement.
If the barbarians quickly gather to attack the city.
The ancients could use glutinous rice, lime, sand and soil to build walls.
She still had to learn how to build cement walls, so she first purchased a batch of glutinous rice and lime and sent them over as soon as possible.
Build the city wall first...
"Thank you God, can you send me another batch of charcoal? All the trees in the city have been eaten up. The wood used to cook porridge now is the wooden planks removed from the damaged houses."
Clover leaves are clear.
It can be imagined that there is nothing left in Zhenguan, it is completely bare, and everything you look around is red and scorched earth.
She agreed.
Today's shopping task was huge. She moved the vase to the passenger side of the pickup truck, tied the rope, and fastened her seat belt.
Drive out of the villa gate.
As soon as she drove out of the gate of the community, someone suddenly rushed out and stopped her car.
She looked closely and saw that it was her aunt and grandma.
She slammed on the brakes, gasping for breath, and beads of sweat formed on her forehead.
It was so dangerous, I almost hit someone!
The aunt and grandma stood in front of the car, staring at her hatefully.
Her grandmother, an old lady in her seventies, had a fierce look in her eyes and looked at her as if she were an enemy.
"You are a loser. You killed my son, and now you have caused my eldest grandson to be imprisoned. Come down, you must follow me to the police station today to withdraw the case!"
Clover was angry.
Since she was born, she has been disliked by her patriarchal grandmother because she is a girl.
Grandma instigated her father more than once, asking him to give all his property to his cousin.
Because my cousin is the first eldest grandson of the old Ye family.
A few days ago, my cousin and Mr. Wang were arrested, and the reporter reported that Mr. Wang and his cousin kidnapped her in the street.
Made local news headlines.
Huawang Group issued a statement overnight. Mr. Wang is not a shareholder of Huawang Group and does not hold any position in the group.
The Ye family was deceived by the huge gift that Mr. Wang said.
After Mr. Wang was imprisoned, his son came to the house every day to make trouble, and the Ye family had to give an explanation.
The aunt and grandma hated Ye MiClong so much that they stopped the car at the gate of the community.
There are four gates in the community, and the other three gates are guarded by other uncles.
When the old lady saw that Ye Clover was indifferent, she suddenly became angry and raised her crutch and hit the front of Ye Clover's car hard.
Bang, bang...
Heavy off-roading makes a harsh knocking sound.
The auntie slapped her car window hard.
